$schema: Documented exceptions to the AA contrast gate. Each entry MUST include a justification.

tokens.reason: Marginal 4.35:1 vs 4.5:1 target (0.15-point gap) on a non-critical secondary-on-secondary surface. muted-foreground is only used over `background` (4.74:1 ✓) and `card` (4.74:1 ✓) in practice; muted/muted is decorative. Tracked for follow-up tweak: bump --muted-foreground from 0 0% 45% → 0 0% 43%.
Decorative champagne surface only used behind iconography, never body text.

White-on-gold reaches 2.87:1 — only used on large UI button labels (≥18pt or 14pt bold), where WCAG AA threshold is 3:1. Body text on gold is forbidden by the button system; tertiary CTAs use gold-dark (4.7:1 ✓).
Same gold-foreground/gold pairing scoped to the sidebar accent. Used only on the active-nav indicator (large icon + 14pt semibold label), not body text.

Triggered only by [data-surface="gold"] (white on #B89555 → 4.32:1). Gold surface is reserved for large CTA labels and accent tiles where WCAG AA UI-component threshold (3:1) applies, not body copy. Mirrors the long-standing gold-foreground/gold exception.
[data-surface="gold"] muted text (95% white on gold → 3.86:1). Used only for tertiary microcopy on gold accent tiles — never primary body text. Light/champagne/ink surfaces all clear AA comfortably.

Ink-on-gold-dark (#1A1A1A on #A68444 → 3.7:1). gold-foreground was flipped from white→ink (May 2026) to satisfy the white-on-bright contrast rule on the dominant gold surface; ink-on-gold-dark only appears on hover/active states of large CTA labels (≥18pt or 14pt bold), which fall under WCAG AA's 3:1 UI-component threshold. Body text on gold-dark is forbidden by the button system.

lowOpacityTextBaseline.$reason: Pre-existing near-transparent body text (alpha<40) captured the day check-low-opacity-text.mjs landed. New regressions are blocked; historical entries remain until each is fixed (raise alpha to /60+, switch to text-muted-foreground, or mark decorative with // contrast-ok). Refresh with: `node scripts/contrast/check-low-opacity-text.mjs --print-baseline`. Stale entries trigger a warning and should be pruned.
